entities.title: Deploying, by hand
entities.summary: The owner runs npm run deploy: npm test, then npm run build, then wrangler deploy.
entities.trigger: The owner, on their own machine. Nothing deploys on a push or a merge.
checks: npm test: tsc --noEmit, then the node:test suites in test/ (the burrows over 300 seeds, the game, the Worker)
npm run build: tsc --noEmit, then build.mjs
secrets: Cloudflare credentials for the icelander.net account, on the owner's machine
notChecked: Behaviour in a real browser: drawing, input, sound and the page's loop (games/lundey/src/.dev/verification.json).
That dist/ holds no .dev folder: build.mjs leaves them out, and only the zizd build step checks it.
Whether the login service knows games:lundey: deployed before it does, the game is reachable by nobody (blockers.json, first-deploy).

entities.title: The lundey zizd pipeline
entities.summary: david-brandt-the-icelander/retro-games:lundey runs the two step containers every game shares: build, then deploy. Its file is listed in .zazzle/zizd/README.md and is not yet in the orchestrator.
entities.trigger: Once registered: a commit on main that changes games/lundey outside its .dev folders, vendor/, the two step folders or the migration gate.
checks: build: npm ci, npm test, npm run build, no .dev folder in dist/, and wrangler deploy --dry-run with the game's own wrangler (.zazzle/zizd/.dev/pipeline.json, build)
deploy: the shared deploy step, which uploads the build's bundle and assets (.zazzle/zizd/.dev/pipeline.json, deploy). Lundey has no database, so the migration gate has nothing of its to hold back
entities.blocks: the deploy step, when the build fails
notChecked: The .dev validators: they are pull-request checks, which zizd does not run.
